Needs changes before merge.

The local code checks passed. The PR body still needs before/after screenshots.

What looks good:

- Dropped model bytes use the existing import command. The new test checks undo.
- The threaded and inline CPU paths use the same preview function. Frame keys and field references remain attached to the result.
- The PR adds no dependencies and changes no golden files or snapshot PNGs.
- `Refs #31` correctly identifies this as partial work.

Local results:

The PR trial-merged without conflicts with upstream main `1b6e08182de405bb0ea10418f229da37fc36031c`.
All commands ran locally in the foreground. No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| App `logging` tests | 5 passed |
| UI library, from `crates/ui` | 959 passed; 6 expected ignores |
| UI `trace_composite` | 4 passed |
| UI `trace_parity` | 5 passed |
| Clippy, app and UI, all targets, `-D warnings` | Passed |

The trace suites used Vulkan llvmpipe with `CAMCRAFT_REQUIRE_GPU=1`. They did not skip the GPU checks.
The gate dry run selected unrelated changes since the fork base. I ran the checks for the touched modules directly.

Safety review:

This PR changes CPU stock preview execution. It does not change posted G-code, collision checks, or the simulation algorithm.
No goldens moved, so there were no golden lines to check.
I repeated two mutations from the PR body in the review worktree:

1. Replaced `crates/ui/src/trace/cpu_eye.rs` with upstream main's version. Compilation failed with E0599: `CpuEye::is_pending` was absent. After restoration, `inline_cpu_eye_marches_without_spawning_a_thread` passed. This red result checks API wiring, not numerical correctness.
2. Replaced `crates/ui/src/egui_app/file_drop.rs` with upstream main's version. `a_bare_name_dropped_mesh_with_bytes_imports_and_undoes` failed with `drop refused: cube.stl is not a readable file`. After restoration, the test passed.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell_web.rs:255` and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/file_drop.rs:55`: Add before/after screenshots to the PR body. Show the changed browser import and stock preview behavior. The review instructions require this evidence for changes under `crates/ui`. Put the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link them from the body. Do not commit them to the PR branch.

Limits and notes:

- Only the native Rust target is installed here. The wasm32 build and live browser execution did not run.
- The source-text assertion for `shell_web.rs` does not prove browser execution. Include the browser and build details with the screenshots.
- The native checks found no additional blocker. The PR stays a draft with `needs-rework` until the evidence is complete.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: none. The requested before/after browser screenshots remain blocked.

The latest review requests screenshots of browser model import and stock preview. I could not obtain valid images on this host.

Checks at unchanged head `28d3295ba3f2e4e3e24c5600abb5b77059d5f1af`:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.
- `web/build-app-wasm.sh` passed for `wasm32-unknown-unknown`, with Clang 19 and wasm-bindgen 0.2.129.
- Chromium 159.0.8154.6 started the app and reported its first frame. The captured canvas was blank.
- An independent WebGPU red-clear test also produced a blank canvas. DOM text rendered correctly.
- Headless ANGLE SwiftShader, Vulkan SwiftShader, and headed Chromium under Xvfb produced no valid canvas image.

I made no source changes. I added no pins because this finding requests image evidence. There is no code mutation to check. I committed and pushed no images, logs, or review evidence. The PR body and head remain unchanged.

This finding remains open. Please re-review after valid browser screenshots are available.
